name: ghost-test-catcher
description: Detect whether AI-generated Python tests are grounded in your actual source code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Ghost Test Catcher can run Doctor and static analysis in untrusted workspaces. Test execution is blocked unless the workspace is trusted or ghostTestCatcher.requireWorkspaceTrustForExecution is disabled.

ghostTestCatcher.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to run the Ghost Test Catcher CLI.

ghostTestCatcher.sourcePaths.description: Source/context paths passed to the analyzer.

ghostTestCatcher.smartSourceContext.description: Automatically include local source files imported by the selected test file before the configured source paths.

ghostTestCatcher.executeTests.description: Run the selected Python tests in an isolated temporary workspace during analysis.

ghostTestCatcher.requireWorkspaceTrustFo.description: Require a trusted VS Code workspace before Ghost Test Catcher executes selected Python tests.

ghostTestCatcher.confirmExecution.description: Ask for confirmation before executing generated or selected tests.

ghostTestCatcher.executionBackend.description: Execution backend for selected Python tests. Docker runs the temporary test workspace in a container image that must include Python and pytest.

ghostTestCatcher.dockerImage.description: Docker image used when ghostTestCatcher.executionBackend is set to docker.

ghostTestCatcher.testMode.description: Expected style of tests being analyzed.

ghostTestCatcher.maxFiles.description: Maximum source/context files read by the analyzer.

ghostTestCatcher.analysisCacheEnabled.description: Cache valid Ghost Test Catcher reports in VS Code workspace state and restore diagnostics after reload.

ghostTestCatcher.cacheFingerprintLimit.description: Maximum Python files fingerprinted per analysis result before caching is skipped.

ghostTestCatcher.testDiscoveryLimit.description: Maximum Python files scanned when populating the VS Code Testing panel.

ghostTestCatcher.ciFailOn.description: Failure policy used by the generated GitHub Actions gate.

ghostTestCatcher.ciPythonVersion.description: Python version used by the generated GitHub Actions gate.

ghostTestCatcher.ciTestPaths.description: Test paths used by the generated GitHub Actions gate.
